notes:
Fixes device file scanning.

• AFC path arguments were sent in the wrong part of the packet, so the iPad ignored them and answered for the root directory every time. Any made-up path looked like a real folder, which sent the sweep into an endless loop of invented directories and reported hundreds of thousands of files that were not there.
• A full sweep of the media partition now completes properly: 22,441 real files in about 45 seconds over USB, instead of running until it hit an internal ceiling.
• The scan now reports how many files it actually looked at, per device.
